import google.generativeai as genai
import os

def record_summary(documents: list[dict]):
    genai.configure(api_key=os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY"))
    model = genai.GenerativeModel('gemini-pro')

    document_texts = []
    for i, doc in enumerate(documents):
        document_texts.append(f"Document {i+1}:\n{doc}\n")

    prompt = "Please summarize the following documents:\n\n" + "\n---\n".join(document_texts)
    
    response = model.generate_content(prompt)
    return {"status": "success", "summary": response.text}

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate
import os

def record_translate(text: str, target_language: str):
    client = translate.Client()

    # Text can also be a list of strings, in which case a list of translations is returned.
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)

    return {"status": "success", "original_text": result["input"], "translated_text": result["translatedText"], "detected_source_language": result["detectedSourceLanguage"]}

from google.cloud import storage
import os

def record_export_archive(bucket_name: str, destination_blob_name: str, data: bytes):
    """Uploads a file to the Google Cloud Storage bucket."""
    # bucket_name = "your-bucket-name"
    # destination_blob_name = "storage-object-name"
    # data = b"your document content"

    storage_client = storage.Client()
    bucket = storage_client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(destination_blob_name)

    blob.upload_from_string(data)

    return {"status": "success", "bucket": bucket_name, "blob": destination_blob_name}
